records.text: Breland reported joining Elephant Clipping’s Discord after an anonymous tip and seeing payments for videos posted from accounts designed to resemble ordinary Americans spontaneously supporting the GOP; he described the operation as astroturfing.
records.speaker: Ali Breland

appearances.snippet: After Anonymous Tipster flagged elephant clipping to me, I was able to access its Discord server and other related political clipping campaign chats just by clicking join, noting on a forum that I was based in the U.S., and answering some questions about my availability and desire to clip. ... Once I was in, I could see the mechanics of the campaign, which pays huge sums of money to people, many of whom appeared to be outside of the U.S. ... to push video clips from accounts that are designed to look like those of ordinary Americans spontaneously touting reasons to favor the GOP. ... Elephant Clippings operation is the newest version of astroturfing. Orchestrated messaging designed to look like genuine expressions of grassroots support, many of these campaigns involve private chat rooms, and Matt Serviuos seems to have been running the campaign for some time.
